practiceReport.name: Jake Ferguson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday; remains sidelined from practice
practiceReport.beatComment: Per Todd Archer of ESPN.com, Ferguson was present for the Cowboys' walkthrough Monday, but he wouldn't have been able to take any reps had the team held a traditional practice session. Ferguson, who has missed two straight contests, will have two more chances to potentially upgrade his practice activity this week before the Cowboys make a call on his status for Thursday's game against the Eagles.

practiceReport.beatComment: Thompson was a full participant in practice both Thursday and Friday, but the veteran safety is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve. He'll end up missing an eighth consecutive game due to a hamstring injury he picked up in Week 3 against the Ravens. Thompson's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Eagles on Thanksgiving Day.

practiceReport.name: Dee Winters
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (81%)
practiceReport.beatComment: The veteran linebacker was injured in Sunday's win over the Titans and was unable to return to the contest. Now on a short week ahead of Thursday's game against the Eagles, Winters will be up against the clock to get ready for the Thanksgiving contest. DeMarvion Overshown would likely draw the start in Winters' place if the latter is unable to play.

practiceReport.name: Donovan Ezeiruaku
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Ezeiruaku didn't play against the 49ers in Week 10 due to an ankle injury. He's avoided an injury tag for Week 11 after logging a full practice Friday, and his return means less rotational snaps at the edge rusher position will be available for James Houston and Von Miller. Ezeiruaku has 32 tackles (16 solo), including 2.5 sacks, and one forced fumble across nine regular-season games.

irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Bland was placed on injured reserve Sunday after suffering an ankle injury during the Week 10 loss to the 49ers, but the injury is not expected to be season-ending.
